summarization:

1. **Title Bar**: The top of the screen has a title bar with the text "Father's Day."
2. **Image**: The central part of the screen features an image of a father and two children holding hands and walking on a beach during sunset. The image includes a heartfelt message: "Your guiding hand on my shoulder will remain with me forever. Thanks for always being there, Dear Dad. Happy Father's Day!"

   - A back arrow icon to return to the previous screen.
   - A download icon to save the image.
   - A WhatsApp icon to share the image via WhatsApp.
   - A share icon to share the image through other available apps or platforms.
